preconditions.description: The length of the string S is greater than 1 and less than 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S consists only of characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: output == sum(1 for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S)) if S[i:j+1].count('1') > S[i:j+1].count('0'))
postconditions.description: The output is the number of substrings of S that have more 1s than 0s.
